final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.Name AS n, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS p, AVG(CASE WHEN t.Milliseconds = 0 THEN NULL ELSE t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds END) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.n, s1.p, s1.r, CASE WHEN s2.a = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s1.r * 1.0 / s2.a END AS q FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL
